blind.description: A stylized wooden pipe organ featuring an ornate carved dark brown wooden casework with decorative molding and pediments. Golden-yellow metallic organ pipes of varying heights are arranged into three main towers/sections. The lower front features a keyboard console with visible keys and an attached wooden organist bench. The back reveals flat wooden paneling and the flat reverse of the pipe casing. Surfaces are solid, manifold, and continuous with hand-painted textures, sitting flat on the floor without extra bases or floating elements.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it has a stepped rectangular silhouette with rectangular side tower caps, a central forward-projecting keyboard console and bench, and exposed tops of the pipe rows between the wooden pillars.
blind.height_vs_figure: slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 6.5 to 7 feet tall) and about as wide as the figure is tall (approx. 5.5 to 6 feet wide)
